definitions.explanation: Having a pleasant, relaxed, and friendly atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {和|なご}やかな⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed in a harmonious atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和|なご}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{和|なご}やかな⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}きたい→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: I want to build a harmonious home.

notes:
{和|なご}やか is a na-adjective describing a warm, peaceful atmosphere where people interact harmoniously.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {和|なご}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- Noun form: {和|なご}やかさ (the quality of being harmonious)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和|なご}やかな⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: harmonious atmosphere
- {和|なご}やかな⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧: peaceful home
- {和|なご}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to proceed smoothly
- {和|なご}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time peacefully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧: calm, gentle (often about personality or weather)
- {和|なご}やか: focuses on interpersonal harmony, warmth

The kanji {和|なご} relates to harmony, peace, and Japan itself.
